artifact.title: Council review of standardized visual governance reports for significant pull requests

findings: APPROVE_WITH_CORRECTIONS_FOR_BOUNDED_PILOT
Visual state must remain downstream of authoritative governance state
Keep review/check/authorization/merge/readback/claim predicates distinct

obligations: Assess strategic leverage and reviewer-value hypothesis
findings: APPROVE_FOR_BOUNDED_PILOT
Likely high leverage through reduced orientation cost and improved anomaly detection

obligations: Define pilot, controls, metrics, and falsification criteria
findings: APPROVE_WITH_CORRECTIONS_FOR_BOUNDED_PILOT
Measure orientation accuracy, blocker detection, stale detection, source/render disagreement, latency, cost, and accessibility
Initial enforcement must remain advisory

obligations: Review information architecture and significance classification
findings: APPROVE_WITH_CORRECTIONS_FOR_BOUNDED_PILOT
Use common core plus domain modules
Define machine-readable significance profile with governed overrides

obligations: Assess machine derivability, exact-head binding, and freshness
findings: APPROVE_WITH_CORRECTIONS_FOR_BOUNDED_PILOT
Every rendered fact must trace to structured source state
Bind report identity, exact head, observation time, source digest, schema/generator versions, and freshness
Text and graphic derivatives must share one canonical input

obligations: Attack misleading-green, stale-head, partial-evidence, actor-confusion, and omission cases
findings: APPROVE_WITH_CORRECTIONS_FOR_BOUNDED_PILOT
Retain stale-head, wrong-head approval/disposition, partial-check, missing-field, incomplete-readback, hidden-obligation, historical-erasure, and content-mismatch fixtures
Unconstrained generative content cannot be canonical operative status
APPROVE_WITH_CORRECTIONS_FOR_BOUNDED_PILOT
Define versioned pr_visual_status_report input schema
Canonical JSON is the authoritative derived report object; visual/text outputs are derivatives
Unknown/inconsistent inputs map fail-closed
APPROVE_FOR_BOUNDED_PILOT
Primary visual should answer identity, exact object, approvals, open obligations, and advancement safety within roughly one minute
APPROVE_WITH_CORRECTIONS_FOR_BOUNDED_PILOT
Use stable order identity/state -> authority/review -> provenance -> validation -> protected integration -> residuals -> conclusion
Permit domain modules and suppress empty sections
APPROVE_WITH_CORRECTIONS_FOR_BOUNDED_PILOT
Avoid ambiguous approved/complete/clean/verified without named object
Standardize review/check/authorization/merge/readback/stale/unknown states and keep campaign dispositions separate

obligations: Review continuity, supersession, provenance, and final integration
findings: APPROVE_WITH_CORRECTIONS_FOR_BOUNDED_PILOT
Treat reports as governed documentary derivatives
Retain material state transitions plus review/authorization and final protected-complete reports
Require textual/structured equivalent and supersession identity
APPROVE_WITH_CORRECTIONS_FOR_BOUNDED_PILOT
Later green state must not erase prior failed checks, rejected reviews, lateness, or superseded dispositions
External source provenance remains in its own authority records

obligations: Review deterministic rendering and GitHub transport
findings: APPROVE_WITH_CORRECTIONS_FOR_BOUNDED_PILOT
Use collectors -> normalized JSON -> deterministic renderer -> text/visual derivatives -> PR surface + archive
Attachment must not mutate candidate head
Event-driven regeneration must be idempotent
APPROVE_FOR_BOUNDED_PILOT
Require readable/printable layout, non-color-only status, monospace exact identities, and accessible text equivalent
APPROVE_WITH_CORRECTIONS_FOR_BOUNDED_PILOT
Quorum achieved at 15/15 offices
15/15 support bounded pilot; no return or reject position
Pilot must be deterministic, source-bound, fail-closed, and advisory before any mandatory gate

conflicts: No adoption-blocking conflict; PRVSR-C01 through PRVSR-C10 and Human Steward/protected admission remain pending

integration_notes: Protected merge, artifact-ledger and terminology integration pending

unresolved_obligations.description: Define canonical state/authority model before pilot implementation.
Define machine-readable significant-PR profile before automatic scope selection.
Define canonical report-input schema and modular architecture before renderer implementation.
Implement deterministic provenance-bound rendering and automatic stale invalidation before first live pilot report.
Install fail-closed adversarial suite before first live pilot report.
Constrain canonical operative content to deterministic structured data before first live pilot report.
Provide accessible equivalent textual/structured surface before pilot acceptance.
Define continuity, retention, supersession, and historical-integrity rules before pilot acceptance.
Establish non-mutating PR transport and stable archival channel before live pilot integration.
Run advisory measured pilot and require separate adjudication before any mandatory policy gate.

blockers: Protected admission and final Amanuensis integration pending
